data.content:
# What are HTLCs?

HTLCs *(Hash Time-Locked Contracts)* combine a **hashlock** (reveal a secret) with a **timelock** (refund after timeout). This enables several powerful patterns:

- **Trustless exchanges** — Swap assets across chains without intermediaries (Atomic Swaps).
- **Conditional payments** — Money is released only if a condition is met, otherwise refunded automatically.
- **Lightning Network** — HTLCs power routed, off-chain payments with built-in refund safety.

```
OP_IF
    OP_SHA256 <secret_hash> OP_EQUALVERIFY
    <receiver_pubkey> OP_CHECKSIG
OP_ELSE
    <refund_locktime> OP_CHECKLOCKTIMEVERIFY OP_DROP
    <sender_pubkey> OP_CHECKSIG
OP_ENDIF
```
